policy: Frozen before the implementation. Old B2 is main a7bb571; new B2 is this branch. Targets: every lengthening edit PR #100 refused (C02 and the line-decoration cases) and the two places of the survey with room below the following lines. A following element moves only when its own candidate id is approved; acknowledge_inference or a line decoration approval never approves another element. Every step approves exactly the candidates its own proposals list; an approval is never carried from one step to another. A refusal ends its case and never counts as success; the first save and the edit back are counted apart; fixture successes are reported apart from real-PDF successes. No frame is widened without a region shown by the page; nothing is pushed off the page, shrunk, painted over or overlapped to fit.
procedure: propose; record the chain and line decoration candidates
save without approving them (a step needing one must be refused)
propose again approving exactly the listed candidates until no new one is listed (3 rounds at most); save approving them
reopen the saved PDF alone and edit back the same way
measures: saved or refused (reason); the existing audits (safety, quality: indesign_evaluate.audit over the edited and following paragraphs, unchanged); structure; continued editing; moves (moved elements translated exactly, nothing left, other paint unchanged); links; placement (inside the page, no new ink under the moved elements); raster of the moved elements; the edit back against the source: glyph origins (0.01 pt, 0.001 pt), line breaks, MuPDF and Poppler text, search, drawings, images, links (0.001 pt), structure; pixels at 72 and 150 dpi reported apart
target: at least one real lengthening edit refused before is saved; else the evidence of what stops it
